subject: Final go/no-go: countersign & start-slot coordination
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@starlite-retail.com>, Tom Henderson <thenderson@starlite-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Final go/no-go: countersign & start-slot coordination

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Attached is the current mutual action plan (MAP_Starlite_v3.pdf) and our latest SOW (Draft_SOW_v2.docx). Per procurement and your timeline, I want to capture the final go/no-go gate and make the signature cadence explicit so legal / procurement can prepare.

Quick summary of our proposal:
- Countersign window we recommend: DocuSign envelope sent Sep 3 (10:00 PT) -> expect countersign by Sep 8.
- PO target: Sep 15 (customer request).
- Proposed start date for rollout/engagement: Sep 30. This gives us two full weeks for final testing and onboarding prep.
- We recommend a 2-week rolling activation (canary -> ramp -> full) to reduce launch risk; Priyom can validate the staging cadence.

Can you confirm the countersign/PO dates above, and whether the Sep 30 start date works for you? If procurement needs an alternate timeline, give me a hard date and we'll try to accommodate.

Next steps from our side if you confirm:
1) I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope with the final SOW and MAP, plus the signature instructions PDF.
2) Marissa will lock in CS onboarding slots (we’ll need sign-off by Sep 10 to secure the resource window).
3) Priyom will schedule the canary validation window the week prior to start.

Attachments: MAP_Starlite_v3.pdf, Draft_SOW_v2.docx

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@starlite-retail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Henderson <thenderson@starlite-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final go/no-go: countersign & start-slot coordination

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear plan. Procurement reviewed the SOW and MAP during our call; high level items: PO issuance by Sep 15 is our target (finance needs that for Q3 closing). Legal indicated they will try to countersign by Sep 8 but asked for one minor data-retention clause to be present in the SOW. I attached an annotated version of the MAP with one small change to the onboarding owner (MAP_Starlite_v3_annotated.pdf).

Proposed adjustments:
- Please add the data-retention clause to the SOW (we’ve marked the suggested language in the MAP).
- Can we shift the DocuSign send to Sep 3 as you suggested — procurement will prioritize the envelope on their side if the send date is explicit.
- Preferred start date for us would be Sep 28 (we have a product freeze week Sep 21–25). If you need the 30th instead, that's fine but earlier is preferable.

If you can confirm the SOW update and the Sep 3 send, I’ll coordinate PO timing internally.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
VP, Digital Experience
Starlite Retail
 elena.martinez@starlite-retail.com
Attachment: MAP_Starlite_v3_annotated.pdf

Subject: Re: Final go/no-go: countersign & start-slot coordination

Thanks — quick technical notes from my side:

- We can support a canary activation starting Sep 28 or Sep 29; to be conservative I’d ask for Sep 29 as the first in-production canary (that gives one extra day after legal countersign).
- Staging validation timeline (recommended): Sep 22–24 runbook dry-run; Sep 25–27 final verification; Sep 29 canary (small cohort); Oct 6 ramp to full.
- SOW: I reviewed the data-retention language and it’s straightforward to implement. Please attach the SOW-final-markup.docx and I’ll confirm the ops checklist.

Operational asks:
1) Confirm the signer list for DocuSign (we need recipient emails and order).
2) Let me know if your security team requires an additional audit log CSV export spec — we can deliver it in week 1 post-start.

I’ll prepare the deployment runbook and share a draft link once I incorporate final SOW language.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Looping in CS plan and resource constraints —

Thanks team. From an onboarding capacity perspective we need signature by Sep 10 to guarantee the professional services blocks for the Sep 28–Oct 15 window. If signatures slip beyond Sep 10 we may need to push the start date by one week due to calendar conflicts.

Proposed CS plan (high level):
- Pre-kickoff (week of Sep 14): stakeholder alignment call, dataset handoff, access provisioning.
- Week 1 (Sep 28–Oct 2): technical onboarding + runbook rehearsal (if start remains Sep 28).
- Week 2 (Oct 5–9): pilot monitoring and adjustments.

I can slot a kickoff standup for Sep 30 at 09:00 PT if we land on the Sep 28 start (that gives time to complete canary week).

Action items for procurement/legal: please confirm signer order and whether we should add an addendum for training days so the SOW is explicit.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Final go/no-go: countersign & start-slot coordination

Everyone —

Thanks for the quick responses. We have enough to call this a GO contingent on the SOW update you requested, Elena. Finalized decisions below and explicit next steps.

Final decisions (agreed):
- Go/No-go: GO (contingent on SOW update with data-retention language).
- DocuSign send: Sep 3, 10:00 PT (I will create envelope and set signer order; please confirm final signer emails by EOD Sep 2).
- Expected countersign complete: Sep 8.
- PO target from Starlite: Sep 15.
- Start date: Sep 30 (we will accept Sep 28 if procurement confirms PO earlier, but scheduling constraints make Sep 30 safer).
- Activation cadence: 1-week canary (Sep 29–Oct 5) then ramp to full by Oct 6.

Action items:
- Elena / Tom: confirm signer list + any final SOW redlines (deadline: EOD Sep 2).
- Elena: confirm whether procurement can guarantee a PO by Sep 15 if DocuSign is sent Sep 3.
- Priyom: finalize runbook and share the deployment checklist (by Sep 9).
- Marissa: hold onboarding blocks and confirm kickoff standup time (target Sep 30, 09:00 PT).
- I will prepare and send the DocuSign envelope on Sep 3 and attach the Signature-instructions.pdf and Onboarding-kickoff-agenda.pdf.

If we hit the Sep 10 sign-off internally (for PS scheduling) we’ll be able to execute the Sep 30 start as planned. If anything slips, I’ll call an immediate sync to rebaseline dates.

Thanks — let’s get the signer list in and I’ll queue the envelope.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124
Attachment: Signature-instructions.pdf, Onboarding-kickoff-agenda.pdf
